messages:
meera: Heads up — on-device bringup for q8b-int4 (tflite) shows large embedding drift vs hosted. Quick triage?
jon: Oof. Repro locally? full model name + tokenizer version?
meera: repro on my laptop. model: q8b-int4-v2-tflite, compiled with sentencepiece v0.1. runtime (hosted) uses spm v0.2. suspect tokenization mismatch. example input: "What's the weather in Zürich?"
kai: That umlaut often exposes tokenizer differences. Can you paste tokenized outputs + embed cosine?
meera: token outputs: 
```
# on-device (spm v0.1)
['▁What', "'s", '▁the', '▁weather', '▁in', '▁Zür', 'ich', '?']
# hosted (spm v0.2)
['▁What', "'s", '▁the', '▁weather', '▁in', '▁Zürich', '?']
```
cosine(hosted, device) = 0.72 (for this prompt) vs typical 0.98 for en-only prompts
jon: 0.72 is huge. Likely different token boundaries causing different positional KV cache alignment -> downstream embed mismatch.
sophia: cc @label-ops — if this is systematic we should pause any golden/holdout refresh that uses the tflite pipeline. Could generate noise in evals.
meera: Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) generate a small diagnostic set (200 multilingual samples with diacritics), 2) freeze a mini-golden and send to label-ops for quick relabel (50 priority), 3) patch the tflite build to use spm v0.2 or normalize tokens in preproc.
kai: I can run a quick compare script. Run: 
```
./tools/token_cmp.py --model q8b-int4-v2-tflite --tokenizer v0.1 --ref-tokenizer v0.2 --out diff.csv
python ./tools/embed_diff.py --pairs diff.csv --metric cosine --out embed_deltas.json
```
I'll push results in ~30m.
meera: thanks. I'll spin up the diagnostic sampler: sample 200 from multilingual seedbank (focus: de, fr, es, tr, sv).
sophia: label-ops can take the frozen 50 for priority relabeling tomorrow. ETA 24h.
curation-bot: Golden set alert: pausing auto-refresh for pipeline tflite-bridge until 2026-03-24T12:00Z (reason: tokenizer mismatch detected by eng-ml).
label-ops: Acknowledged. We'll standby for the bundle and annotate with the "on-device-smoke" tag.
jon: Also add a quick unit test into ci: assert tokenization parity for canonical unicode normalization NFKC and spm v0.2 -> fail build if mismatch.
meera: +1. Action items summary:
- kai: produce token + embed diffs (due +30m)
- meera: assemble 200 diagnostic set + freeze 50 golden (due +2h)
- sophia/label-ops: relabel 50 priority (ETA 24h)
- eng-runtime: pin spm v0.2 in tflite compile or add normalizer (follow-up ticket)
jon: I'll open the follow-up ticket and add CI test.
sophia: will we need to backfill any existing golden examples that might have been ingested with v0.1?
meera: likely a small migration script. If diffs >0.1 cosine for golden items we should flag for relabel.
curation-bot: New ticket created: CTC-1421 "on-device tokenizer parity + mini-golden" and assigned to jon, meera.
kai: uploaded diff CSV & embed_deltas.json to /tmp/ondevice-diffs-1788882468.tar.gz (link: https://internal.storage/redwood/ondevice-diffs-1788882468)
meera: pulled them, spot-checked – about 12% of the diagnostic set has cosine < 0.85. I'll document in the ticket.
label-ops: prepping annotation queue named ondevice-smoke/priority-50.
jon: reopening model onboarding checklist: add step "tokenizer parity verification" for any compiled on-device artifact.
meera: thanks everyone. moving to infra to run a full sweep after the relabel batch completes. :white_check_mark:
